+# Incident Postmortem: EdgeClientRequestJitter & BooklogrApiLatencyP99High
+
+## Summary
+The `booklogr-api` service experienced high p99 HTTP latency (>2.4s) and edge client request jitter. The root cause was a combination of disabled response caching (`CACHE_TYPE = "NullCache"` introduced in commit `f127661`), long 30-second HTTP request timeouts when querying external providers in `BookProvider`, and default fallback configuration attempting to reach external domain `https://metadata.booklogr.app` instead of the local metadata instance at `http://book-metadata:8080`.
+
+## Root Cause
+1. Commit `f127661` changed `CACHE_TYPE` in `api/config.py` from `"SimpleCache"` to `"NullCache"`. This disabled Flask `@cache.cached` response caching on `/v1/books/search`, forcing every search request to execute live provider lookups.
+2. In `api/book_provider.py`, HTTP lookups for external metadata providers (`https://openlibrary.org` and `https://metadata.booklogr.app`) had a 30-second timeout. Because external network access is blocked/unavailable in the deployment environment, requests to primary provider (`openlibrary`) timed out for 30s before falling back to `https://metadata.booklogr.app`, which also timed out for 30s.
+3. This blocked sync Gunicorn worker threads (`-w 4`) for 30–60s per request, quickly exhausting available workers and causing request queuing, severe latency spikes (p99 > 2.4s), and traffic generator jitter.
+
+## Key Evidence Used
+- Alertmanager active alerts: `BooklogrApiLatencyP99High` (p99 latency 2.485s vs 300ms threshold) and `EdgeClientRequestJitter`.
+- Prometheus metrics (`flask_http_request_duration_seconds`): `/v1/books/search` endpoint had high average duration (~1.37s to >2.4s).
+- Prometheus targets (`/api/v1/targets`): Showed `book-metadata:8080` active in the internal network environment and responding instantly (`curl http://book-metadata:8080/v1/search/test`).
+- Git commit inspection (`git show f127661`): Identified commit disabling response caching by setting `CACHE_TYPE = "NullCache"`.
+- Connectivity tests (`curl` with `-m 5`): Confirmed external domain requests to `https://openlibrary.org` and `https://metadata.booklogr.app` timed out due to no internet access in the isolated environment.
+
+## Changes Made
+1. **`api/config.py`**:
+   - Re-enabled response caching by setting `CACHE_TYPE = os.environ.get("CACHE_TYPE", "SimpleCache")`.
+   - Updated default `DATA_PROVIDER_FALLBACK` to point to the local service `http://book-metadata:8080`.
+2. **`api/book_provider.py`**:
+   - Updated default fallback URL from `https://metadata.booklogr.app` to `http://book-metadata:8080`.
+   - Reduced outbound HTTP request timeouts from 30s to 3s to prevent Gunicorn worker thread starvation when primary providers fail.
+
+## Verification
+- Verified git status and staged edits.
+- Confirmed `http://book-metadata:8080` returns responses in milliseconds.
